content: Yakub Labonor hentu dáigiyegoi
Bade Labonor futainde endilla hodde Yakube fuinne, "Ãrar bafor hár kissu Yakube loifelaiye, ãrar baforgunottu hite ei šombotti okkol goijje."
Yakube Labonor siyarar mikka kiyal goijje, ar so, Labon Yakub loi agor ḍoilla nai.
Hetunot Mabude Yakubore hodde, "Tui tor bafor dešot tor egena okkolor hãse uwafes firizagoi, ar ãi tor fũwati takiyum."
Toi Yakube hóbor defeṛaiye edde Rahelare edde Leare maṛot hibar zanuwaror zãk asede heṛe ḍaikke.
Hitarare hodde, "Ãi tũwarar bafor siyarar sai buzi faijji ze ãr loi tũwarar baf agor ḍoilla nai, kintu ãr bafor Allah ãr fũwati ase.
Ar tũwara nize o zanode hota, ãi ãr hár bol šokti diyore tũwarar bafolla gulami goijji.
Tarfore o tũwarar bafe ãre ṭokaiye edde ehon foijjonto doš bar ãr beton bodol goijje, kintu Allaye hibare ãre hoti goitto no de.
Hibaye zodi hoito, 'dagwalagun oibo tor beton,' henot hár zãke dagwala so biyaito; ar zodi hoito, 'sitaragun tor beton oibo,' henot zãke sitara so biyaito.
Ei bafe Allaye tũwarar bafor zanuwaror zãkgun loifelaiye edde ãre diye.
"Zanuwaror zãk okkole zurzade musumot ãi ekbar šopponot suk tuli sailam ze sai sool okkolor uwore ze faṛa sool okkol uiṭṭe hin beggun sitara edde ḍõr šoṛo dagwala.
Tarfore Allar firistaye ãre šopponot hodde, 'Yakub.' Ar ãi hoidde, 'Oto, ãi eṛe asi.'
Toi hibaye hodde, 'Tor suk tuli sa, faṛa sool okkol zin zanuwaror zãkor uwore uṛer hin sitara, šoro ḍõr dagwala, kiyollahoile Labone tor loi goredde hin beggun ãi dekki.
Ãi he Betelor Allah, zeṛe tui ek kúṛar uwore tel ḍali diyore ãr hãse manoš goijjili. Uṭ, tui ehon ei deššanottu niyoli zagoi edde tui zormo oiyosde dešot uwafes firizagoi.'"
Toi Rahela edde Leaye hodde, "Ãrattu ki ãrar bafor góttu ehono mirazor bag ase ne?
Hibaye ki ãrare bidešitta hisabe no goner ne? Hibaye ãrare besifelaiye edde ãralla ze ṭiya diya oil hin hibaye háifelaiye.
Ei šombotti Allaye ãrar bafottu ãra edde ãrar futziyaindolla hari loiyede. Ar hetolla ehon Allaye tũware za kissu hoiye tũi hen goro."
Toi Yakube hibar fuwain edde bouwaindore ũṛor fiṛot tuli diye,
edde hibaye hibar hár zanuwar zãk šoho aro dusora dón šombotti zin Paddan Aramot hamail hin beggun o fũwati loiye, Kenanot hibar baf Isakor hãse zaiboilla.
Ar zẽtte Labone hitar berasoolor kẽš ãsaibolla gil, Rahelaye hibar bafor góror muttigunore suri goijje.
Ar Yakube Aramiyo Labonore dúha diye, kiyollahoile Yakube dái zargoide he babute o hoi no za.
Ar ebafe Yakubor za kissu aššil hin loi hiba hentu dái giyegoi, Fúrat hal farai giye edde Giliyad faharor mikka giye.
Yakubore Labone fisottu lorai giye
Ar tin din bade Labonore howa oiye ze Yakub dái giyegoi.
Toi hite hitar egena okkolore fũwati loiyore hãt dinor fõt foijjonto Yakubore lorai loigiye edde Giliyad faharot hibare lot faiye.
Kintu Allah raitta šopponot Aramiyo Labonor hãse ai hodde, "Hũšiyar, Yakubore bala horaf kissu no hois."
Ar zẽtte Labone Yakub loi dola oiye, hẽtte Yakube Giliyad faharor uwore ṭambu gãijjil, ar Labon edde hitar egena okkole o heṛe ṭambu gãijje.
Bade Labone Yakubore hodde, "Tui in ki goijjos? Tui ãre dúha diyos, ar ãr ziyaingunore larair bondir ḍoilla gori kiyolla loi aiššos?
Tui nizamot kiyolla dáiyos edde ãre dúha diyos? Tui ãre no hos kiyolla? Toi zene ãi tore kušir sãte gan, tobla edde bina bazaiyore bidai goritam.
Tui kene ãr nati edde ziyaindore suma dito foijjonto no dili? Tui endilla ham goriyore bekufai goijjos.
Tũwarar hoti goribar šokti ãr hatot ase, kintu gelde raitta tũwarar bafor Allaye ãre hodde, 'Hũšiyar, Yakubore bala horaf kissu no hois.'
Ar ehon tor bafor górot zaibolla oitofare tottu foran handedde hetolla tui ai giyosgoide, kintu ãr góror muttigun kiyolla sur goijjos?"
Yakube zuwabe hodde, "Ãi ḍorailam, kiyollahoile ãi baffilam, tũi zodi zurgori ãttu tũwar ziyaindore hari loi rakido.

Tũi zar hãse tũwar muttigun faiba, hitare marifela oibo. Ãr hár zinišfatir butore tũwar hono kissu takile tũwar egena okkolor sarme hin talaš gori loifelo." Asole Yakube no zanito ze, Rahelaye hin suri goijje.
Toi Labone Yakubor ṭambur butore edde Lear ṭambur butore ar dui bandir ṭambur butore góille, kintu kissu no fa. Bade hite Lear ṭambuttu niyoli aiyore Rahelar ṭambur butore góille.
Rahelaye kintu he muttigun loi zai ũṛor godir butore golai eriyore hibar uwore boi aššil. Labone hibar ṭambur hár zagat ataiye, kintu kissu no fa.
Rahelaye hibar bafore hodde, "Malik ãi tũwar sarme uṛi tiyai no farir boli tũi gušša no oiyo, kiyollahoile ãttu ehon mašik oiye." Hetolla Labone talaši gori bade o he muttigun tuwai no fa.
Iyanot Yakub naraz oiyore Labonore hosuri diyore hodde, "Ãr hosuri ki? Ar ãr oinnai o ba ki ze tũi ãre fise fise lorai aiššo?
Ar ãr hár zinišfati sai tũwar góror hono ziniš faiyo ne? Fai takile tũwar egena okkolor sarme rako, edde hitara ãra duni fokkor bisar gorok.
"Ei kuri bosor ãi tũwar hãse roiyi, eṛe butore bera sool ba soole hono so nošto no gore. Ar ãi tũwar soolor zakottu hono faṛa sool o no hái.

Enki fahari zanuware marifelaiyede hendilla hono zanuwarore o ãi tũwar hãse hono din no ani; edde he hoti ãi nize boššiyi. Ar hono zanuwar suri oigilegoi o hin din ok ba rait ok tũwara ãr hãsottu hotifuron loiyo.
Ãi dine fuijji ar raitta ṭanḍa faiyi, edde ãr sukottu gum zaitogoi.
Ei kuri bosor ãi tũwar górot roiyi, tũwar dui ziyolla soiddo bosor, ar so bosor tũwar zanuwarolla gulami goijji. Heṛe butore tũi doš bar foijjonto ãr beton bodolaiyo.

Ãr bafor Allah, ze Ibrahimor Allah edde Isakor Ḍor zodi ãr fokkiya no oito, toile tui ãre ehon hameka hali hate bidai goitta. Kintu Allaye ãr duk edde ãr hator mehennot deikke, ar hetolla hibaye gelde raitta tũware dõk diyede."

Toi Labone zuwabe Yakubore hodde, "Ei mayafuwain okkol ãr ziyain, ei fuwain okkol ãr fuwain, ei zanuwaror zãk oilde ãr zãk. Tui zin dehor in beggun ãr. Ehon ãr ei mayafuwain edde hitarattu oiyede fuwaindore ki goriyum?
Ai, tui loi ãi loi duni zone ekkan wadar sukti gori, ziyan tui edde ãr maze goba oi takibo."
Toi Yakube ugguwa fattor loiyore faiya ḍoilla gori tiya goraiye.
Toi Yakube egena okkolore hodde, "Tũwara o kissu fattor dola goro." Toi hitara fattor ani ugguwa ṭal banaiye, edde beggune hiyanor ḍake há fiya goijje.
Labone he fattoror ṭalguware nam diye Jegar-Šahaduta, ar Yakube hiyanor nam diye Gal-Ed.
Toi Labone hodde, "Ei ṭal oilde aijja tui edde ãr maze goba." Hetolla hiyanore Gal-Ed,
ar Mišfa nam raka oil, kiyollahoile hite hodde, "Ãra ekzon ar ekzonottu dure oiyumde hẽtte Mabude tor edde ãr uwore kiyal rake.
Zodi tui ãr ziyaindor loi horaf bebar goros otóba ãr ziyain takite oinno bou biya goros, zodi o hono manuš ãrar fũwati nai, kintu sais, ãi edde tui, ãrar maze Allah oilde goba."
Labone Yakubore aro hodde, "Ei ṭalguwa edde ei faiyawa, sa, ei tiya goraiya faiya, ziba ãi edde tor maze ãi buwailam.
Ei ṭal oilde ek goba edde faiya oilde ek goba, ze ãi ei ṭal farai tor hoti goitto no zaiyum, ar tui o ei ṭal edde faiya farai ãr hoti goitto no aibi.
Ibrahimor Allah edde Nahuror Allah edde hitarar bafor Allaye ãrar bisar gorok." Toi Yakube hibar baf Isakor Ḍor loi ek hosom háiye.
Bade Yakube he faharot ek kurbani diye edde hibar egena okkolore ek hánar dawat diye. Toi hitara hána háiye edde hitara heṛe rait haṛaiye.
Bade Labone binna sore uṛi nizor nati edde ziyaindore suma diye edde duwa goijje. Tarfore hite hentu giyegoi edde górot firi giyegoi.
